what: Finding 1: step-7a.sh consumes the 7a.r rebase checkpoint exit while the macro still depends on the foreground process exit code
scenario_or_breakage: If rebase-checkpoint-probe.sh exits 1 for a conflict, the proposed no-errexit wrapper continues into pre-bump flush and exits 0, so Step 8 can run while a rebase is in progress
suggested_fix: Do not hide the probe behind an always-zero wrapper; either keep 7a.r as its own SKILL.md foreground call, or have step-7a.sh capture the probe rc, skip later phases on conflict/failure, emit the probe KV, and exit with the probe rc so the existing macro can route correctly

what: Finding 2: sanitizer skip-upsert detection is keyed to a token the current generator usually does not emit
scenario_or_breakage: Real sanitizer rejects emit STATUS=skipped with SKIP_REASON values like pipe-in-node-label, br-in-participant-alias, dollar-in-participant-alias, or unclosed-frontmatter; the planned tests only use synthetic STATUS=failed SKIP_REASON=sanitizer-rejected, so placeholder comments can still be posted after actual sanitizer rejection
suggested_fix: Treat generate-code-flow-diagram.sh STATUS=skipped as sanitizer rejection, or parse code-flow-sanitizer.failure.log for STATUS=rejected/REASON_TOKEN; add harness cases using current real tokens such as pipe-in-node-label

what: Finding 3: the plan removes the 7a.r literal probe call from SKILL.md but does not update the structural macro harness that requires it
scenario_or_breakage: make lint will fail because test-implement-rebase-macro.sh expects exactly four SKILL.md rebase-checkpoint-probe.sh invocations and explicitly requires the 7a.r pair
suggested_fix: Update test-implement-rebase-macro.sh and the macro prose to model 7a.r as delegated through step-7a.sh, or choose the simpler alternative of leaving the 7a.r foreground call in SKILL.md and only extracting diagram/comment/flush work
